name: planet-explorer-mobile
description: Capacitor shell for Planet Explorer. The game itself is the three files in the repo root; www/ is a copy, never an edit target.

scripts.sync: npm run copy && cap sync android
scripts.dev: npm run sync && cap run android
scripts.bundle: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
